stations.title: Your styles
stations.gap: No one place for a colour

captions: The form works. Next, Ruth wants the page in the warmer cream of the new signs.
The colour is typed in forty places, so it takes all afternoon and one is missed.
You move every style into one stylesheet and name the colours, in three tasks.
Now the new cream is one edit, and it reaches the menu links too.
Same page, same look. Every colour now lives in one place.
